resources.string: Your screen, as calm as a printed page.
Draws a paper texture over the screen to mimic an e-ink display. It does not read screen content.
Tap to turn your screen into paper.
Removes color from the whole screen, like ink on paper.
Filters out blue light: close to paper by day, warmer like a lamp in the evening. A warmer Night Light of yours is kept.
Dims whites below the usual minimum brightness: paper reflects light, it does not shine. Strength is set in Android’s settings.
Thicker letters everywhere, full and sharp like print.
Turns off system animations: screens change instantly.
Adds a paper grain and softens pure black, like ink on a page.
Paper with the light theme, ink with the dark one. Your wallpaper comes back when you turn it off.
Needed for grayscale, warm light, extra dim, bold text and still motion. Run this once from a computer with the phone connected:
Granted. Grayscale and still motion are available.
Needed to draw the paper texture. Enable Carta among the accessibility services.
Active. The paper texture can be drawn over every app.
Needed to save your wallpaper and put it back later. Android only allows it through All files access.
Granted. Your wallpaper is saved before it changes.
Grant the system permission first, see Setup.
Grant file access first, see Setup.
Turn Carta on and off from the home screen.
